name: What the Pro Sees
why_it_works: Everyone loves borrowing an expert's eyes for a moment. Freezing one ordinary frame and pointing out what a trained eye catches makes the viewer feel smarter, and it shows mastery far better than claiming it. Next time they see that thing, they will remember who taught them to look.

hook.pattern: Freeze one ordinary image and contrast what the viewer sees with what the expert sees.
examples: Watch this {{subject}}. We see three things.
What did you miss in this {{subject}}?

variables.name: subject
variables.description: The ordinary thing in the frame, lowercase, 3 words or fewer

variables.name: pro_role
variables.description: Who is looking, by lowercase role title, not a real named person, 3 words or fewer

variables.name: detail_1
variables.description: First thing the pro notices, 10 words or fewer
variables.example: The keeper's weight is on his heels

variables.name: detail_2
variables.description: Second thing the pro notices, 10 words or fewer
variables.example: Two defenders are marking the same runner

variables.name: detail_3
variables.description: Third thing, the one that only makes sense in motion, 10 words or fewer
variables.example: The late run to the near post nobody tracks

variables.name: takeaway
variables.description: The lesson in one line, 9 words or fewer
variables.example: Goals are decided before the ball is kicked

variables.name: disclosure
variables.description: Required fine print for the client's niche, from the matching pack in compliance/packs.json
variables.example: Equal Housing Opportunity. Bayline Realty, DRE #01234567.

beats.voiceover: Watch this {{subject}}. We see three things.

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 wide photo of the {{subject}} in its real setting, frozen moment, natural light, slightly desaturated like a paused frame, no visible logos
Vertical tight crop of the same {{subject}} scene focused on '{{detail_1}}', same light and color as the wide frame, room for a drawn circle overlay
Vertical tight crop of the same {{subject}} scene focused on '{{detail_2}}', same light and color, room for an arrow overlay

beats.purpose: detail 3 unfreezes into motion: the payoff
beats.voiceover: And three, the one everyone misses: {{detail_3}}.

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot: the frozen {{subject}} scene comes to life, color returns, camera glides to reveal '{{detail_3}}' in motion, dynamic but smooth, golden natural light

beats.on_screen_text: Follow {{brand}} to see what we see {{disclosure}}
beats.voiceover: Follow {{brand}} and start seeing it too.

cta: Follow {{brand}} for the next breakdown, and tell us what you spotted first.

craft.notes: Keep the image frozen and desaturated for the first two details, drawing circles and arrows in the edit. The third detail is the only one that needs motion, so the frame unfreezing and the color returning is the reveal. That single moving shot earns the hero tier; everything else stays still.

do_not: Use footage or likeness of real athletes, opponents or celebrities without rights and consent
Pick details only an expert could ever see; the viewer should be able to spot them once pointed out
Spend the hero clip if the client has not approved the extra credits; fall back to clip_standard
compliance: Real estate: describe the property, never the people or who a neighborhood is 'right for' (fair housing); show brokerage name; use only listing photos you have rights to
Real estate: no claims about future value or appreciation
